cohort: 470 First Nations infants born at Nepean Hospital in 2018 and their mothers, compared to a control group of 470 non-First Nations infants and their mothers
finding: Despite higher rates of socioeconomic disadvantage and health risk factors among First Nations mothers, there were no significant differences in maternal morbidity or adverse birth outcomes for their infants compared to a non-First Nations control group.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was significantly associated with maternal smoking, hypertension and drug use.
